caption: The drawing features two brown objects centered on a plain, off-white background. The upper object is a round, flat, medallion-like item with a carved design: it displays a symmetrical, petal-like pattern enclosing a central drop shape surrounded by a beaded border, and the entire medallion is edged with a series of short, perpendicular lines. The lower object consists of two stacked cylindrical shapes, both colored in a similar brown hue, with the bottom cylinder being much wider and shorter, and the top cylinder being narrower and taller. The lower cylinder has a smooth, slightly irregular surface, with visible indentations and shading that create a three-dimensional effect. Near the bottom right of the lower object, the name "FRANKLIN SYRES" is printed in red capital letters.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
